questions.question: Can an Azure resource belong to more than one resource group at the same time?

options.why: A resource is in exactly one group.

options.text: Only if they are in the same region
options.why: Region does not matter; still only one group.

questions.explanation: Each resource belongs to exactly one resource group (it can be moved).

questions.question: Which TWO statements about resource groups are true?

options.text: Deleting a resource group deletes all resources in it
Resource groups can be nested inside other resource groups
Resources can be in a different region from their resource group
Each resource group can only hold one resource

questions.explanation: Groups delete their contents and can hold resources from many regions; nesting is not allowed.

questions.question: How should you organise resources into resource groups?

options.text: By shared lifecycle, such as one app in one environment

options.why: Names are not a good grouping criterion.

options.text: All company resources in one group
options.why: This makes access and clean-up risky.

questions.explanation: Group resources that are deployed, managed and deleted together.
questions.scenario: Your team runs a shop app in production and test environments.
